newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Europe aluminium output rises 3.2 pct in 1st half.
newsitem.headline: Europe aluminium output rises 3.2 pct in 1st half.

text.p: European production of primary aluminium increased 3.2 percent to 1.6 million tonnes in the first half of 1996, the European Aluminum Association (EAA) said on Tuesday.
In the second quarter output totalled 806,776 tonnes, an increase of 2.3 percent compared with the same period of last year.

Production in Norway, Germany, France and Spain -- Europe's largest producers -- in the first six months of 1996 increased less than the European average at respectively 2.4 percent for the first two countries, 1.0 percent for France and 0.2 percent for Spain, EEA said.
In contrast, total output rose 10.0 percent in Sweden, 8.9 percent in the Netherlands, 4.4 percent in Britain and 4.3 percent in Italy, which are the other big players in the market.
The EEA said in October it expected European production of primary aluminium to rise to 3.18 million tonnes in 1996 from 3.13 million tonnes last year.
The quarterly figures released on Tuesday do not take into account production in Belgium, Austria and Denmark.
